description:
Mint a short-lived presigned URL that a client (a browser, an app, or the user) can use to upload a file directly to storage, attached to a file session.

Use this when the bytes are NOT on the machine running this server — e.g. the remote/hosted server, or a file the user has in a browser. (If this server also offers a tool that uploads a file from the local machine, prefer it for local files: it performs the upload for you.)

**Easiest for a person:** if the response includes **uploadPageUrl**, give that link to the user. It opens a simple Smartpress upload page in their browser where they pick the file; the page uploads it directly and securely (the file never passes through the chat).

**For a programmatic client:** issue a single HTTP **PUT** to **url** with the raw file bytes as the body and **no extra headers** — do not set Content-Type and do not add x-amz-* headers; everything required is already baked into the URL. The URL expires (default 15 minutes), so use it promptly. Confirm the result with list_session_files.

Returns **uploadPageUrl** (when the server has a public base URL configured), the raw **url**, the assigned **sessionFileId**, the storage **key**, and **expiresAt**.

expiresIn.description: Presigned URL lifetime in seconds (1-3600, default 900).

fileName.description: Name to store the file under, e.g. "artwork.pdf".

fileSessionId.description: File session ID returned by create_file_session.

name: get_file_upload_url
